description: Welcome to the VR spatial navigation experiment. Press the trigger button on the handcontroller to start.

Before we begin, you will be exploring three different virtual environments to learn how to move yourself. You will be navigating each of these environments using three different navigation methods. You will be informed what technique you will be using before each environment and then you will be asked to complete a series of tasks in each environment. Please pay attention to the instructions and follow them carefully.
Press the trigger button to continue.
You have completed the practice session. The investigator will help you take off the headset and prepare for the experiment.

You will now navigate through a maze. There are 12 different objects placed across the maze. 
Press the trigger button to continue.
Congratulations! You have successfully completed the experiment. Thank you for your participation.
